items.caption: A proposed early form of 視 is interpreted as an eye above a standing figure. The standing figure is used to distinguish it from a form read as 見, though the identification remains a paleographic interpretation.
items.alt: Black archaic-style figure with an eye-like shape above a standing person.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the proposed early pictographic form and the scholarly distinction from 見, which helps explain the character’s graphic history.

limitations.text: The person-and-eye reading remains a scholarly interpretation, and individual archaic examples may be disputed. This image is a modern redraw, not an ancient inscription.
